learning_outcomes.text: Complete useful knowledge and concepts in materials science.
Know about creep, fatigue, heat treatments, corrosion, and tribology.
Prepare and defend a project in groups.
Conduct an exhaustive study of a 'materials' application within the apprentice's company for a micro-dissertation, applying knowledge, concepts, and tools acquired during the course.

syllabus_topics: Heat treatments of metals and alloys
assessment_rules: Assessment consists of 2 written assignments and a project defense. The collective evaluation (EVC 1) accounts for 0.33 of the grade, and the individual evaluation (EVI 1) accounts for 0.67. A micro-dissertation, presented in the third year, also contributes to the final assessment.
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
